caption: Our first import failed on all 5 lines because the companies in the file did not exist yet in Positive User. The trial box says 7 days left. The workspace name is hidden.
Without the company column the second import worked: five test contacts at example.com, each showing its e-mail address as the name. The row of the account owner is hidden.
Before sending, the review step flags a Shared domain and suggests adding your own. We did not press Publish. The sender line is hidden.
The trial allows 10 e-mails, shown as Emails left: 10 above the campaign list. Our test campaign was saved with 0 sent.
Pricing with Monthly selected: 89, 239 and 599 euro a month, against 69, 199 and 499 euro billed yearly. The first plan includes up to 5,000 e-mails a month and 5 active workflows.
